entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I need to return an item. It's the VeloBand Pulse heart rate monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I just... it wasn't what I was hoping for.
Okay, I have the order pulled up. Thank you. To make sure I'm on the right track, could you tell me a bit more? Is there a technical fault with the band or is it more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it works fine. It just... it doesn't feel right on my wrist, and to be honest, I really could use the money back for some other things right now. I was hoping to return it.
I see. I'm just confirming the delivery date here... It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you on January 2nd, about 25 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. I've been so busy, I didn't get a chance to call sooner.
I understand. Unfortunately, for the VeloBand Pulse, our return policy is for 10 days from the date of delivery. I'm afraid at 25 days, it is too late to process a return for a refund.
Oh. Really? Only 10 days? I... I thought it was longer. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I've always been so happy. I really was counting on getting that refund.

I do appreciate your loyalty, and I'm sorry for the disappointing news. The reason for that specific policy is strictly for health and safety reasons. Because the device is worn directly on the skin, we have to adhere to strict hygiene protocols.
But I barely wore it. It's perfectly clean. Isn't there any exception you can make? This is really a difficult time for me.

I truly wish I could, but the policy is firm on this one. After that much time has passed, for sanitation reasons, we're unable to accept the item back into our inventory. It's a bio-contaminant risk we can't take. The system physically won't allow me to create a return label.
So... I'm just stuck with it? I just don't know what to do. That's a lot of money to lose.
I'm very sorry, but yes, we are unable to process the return. The policy is in place to protect all our customers. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No... I guess not. Thank you for your time.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
